authorization.scope: User-authorized small stock-and-ETF strategy trial, with executable stage selection and a fixed mixture comparator
authorization.phi_delivery: Contract and short explanation only; no economic run, fitting, download, search or agent
authorization.prior_40_day_stock_candidate: Preserve all old contracts, code, results and saved manifest unchanged; this is a new trial
authorization.superseded_gate: The previous proposed historical static Sharpe>=1 prerequisite does not apply to this authorized stage-selection trial

question: Does a frozen A-share opportunity-state rule selecting between S01 stocks and ETF price-rule allocation improve after-cost Sharpe over a fixed 50/50 allocation to these same two candidates?

budget.signal_derivations: One causal four-ETF score table and reuse/mapping of existing stock states/rankings; not model training or shadow account simulation
budget.technical_fixes: Preserve failed attempts and error evidence; rerun only a documented correctness fix with unchanged financial rules, bounded to these four account identities

period.calendar_gate: Same ordered dates must match accepted stock inputs and ETF calendar exactly; do not shorten by dropping inconvenient sessions
period.warmup: Reuse pre-2025 prices/events and frozen prediction/state inputs only; first ETF score needs61 genuine closes and60 event-normalized daily returns
period.first_signal: Evaluation index0 close, 2025-01-02; earliest execution is next common session, 2025-01-03
period.cross_year: Continuous lots, acquisition dates, cash, marks, tax bases, entitlements and receivables; no January reset
period.terminal_treatment: Final-close mark including valid receivables and stock estimated dividend tax liability; no forced terminal liquidation or future execution
period.research_label: Exploratory already-viewed historical period, not blind validation

STOCK_S01.mechanism: Existing conditional A-share stock ranking policy; it incorporates E00 and T01 rather than counting them as independent allocations
STOCK_S01.rankings: Reuse exact frozen E00 predictions and T01 ret60/ret120/momentum20_skip5 percentile-mean rankings and their point-in-time stock pools
STOCK_S01.internal_rule: At each five-session stock node, select T01 iff CSI300 ret20>0 and CSI300 close/MA60-1>0; otherwise E00, as in accepted S01
STOCK_S01.inventory_selection: Existing top80 selection with held-stock retention within top120, using this mixed account's actual stock inventory
STOCK_S01.planning_budget: stock_fraction*signal_total_NAV/80 per selected stock; preserve original lot rounding, fee reserve and small-pool cash remainder
STOCK_S01.buy_cap: Original 3percent stock cap applied to stock_fraction*opening_total_NAV; retain existing holdings above cap and permit sales, never apply this cap to ETF units
STOCK_S01.no_extra_candidates: E00, T01 and S01 do not each receive a separate fixed-mixture weight; old standalone accounts remain descriptive references

ETF_R60_TOP2.mechanism: Positive own-price trend and cross-asset risk-adjusted relative strength, without new ML
ETF_R60_TOP2.gross_factor: Reuse canonical parent raw-price-plus-events total-return factor g[d]; theoretical signal reinvestment is separate from actual account cash
ETF_R60_TOP2.score: Q=R60/(sqrt(60)*s60); valid only when all60 observations are finite and s60>0
ETF_R60_TOP2.ranking: At each ETF node sort valid positive Q descending; exact ties by six-digit product code ascending
ETF_R60_TOP2.weights_within_candidate: First two positive-score ETFs each0.50. If one qualifies, allocate0.50 and leave0.50 cash; if none qualifies, all cash. Do not renormalize a single survivor to100percent
ETF_R60_TOP2.missing: First node requires valid scores for all four; later invalid ETF scores excluded and logged, not filled or window-adjusted. More than10percent ETF nodes with any invalid score invalidates input readiness
ETF_R60_TOP2.no_extra_signals: No NAV premium, FX overlay, future overseas close, sector expansion, leverage or shorts; CNY ETF prices already include FX
ETF_R60_TOP2.scope: New frozen price-rule hypothesis, not an asserted low-correlation strategy and not evidence of trend superiority

selector.decision_indices: 0,40,80,...,400, at that session close; no start-offset alternatives
selector.M: M_csi300_ma60_distance: CSI300 close / trailing60-session mean close -1
selector.B: B_pool_share_above_ma60: share of eligible point-in-time stocks above own trailing60-session mean
selector.ready: M,B finite, contemporaneous pool provenance valid, B_coverage>=0.80; only required M/B readiness, not unrelated P readiness
selector.rule: When ready and M>0 and B>0.50 choose STOCK_S01 with stock_fraction1 and ETF_fraction0; otherwise choose ETF_R60_TOP2 with stock_fraction0 and ETF_fraction1
selector.mechanism: A-share market strength with broad participation favors stock selection; weak or narrow A-share participation delegates to a multi-asset opportunity rule. This is a fixed financial hypothesis, not a proven regime map
selector.missing_rule: An invalid outer state uses ETF_R60_TOP2 and logs fallback; >10percent outer nodes invalid stops economic interpretation, not a fitted rescue
selector.identity_lock: Lock STOCK_S01 or ETF_R60_TOP2 for40 sessions. S01's existing E00/T01 internal choice may still change every5 sessions; ETF constituents may change every20. No unscheduled outer switch
selector.no_performance_selector: No trailing120-day Sharpe, realized candidate return winner, threshold fit, volatility overlay or shadow NAV input

fixed_comparator.timing: Same five-session stock clock and20-session ETF clock, both anchored at index0. At each family node use its fixed fraction of current totalNAV to form targets. Allocation can drift between nodes and due to rejected trades
fixed_comparator.comparison: This is an actual mixed inventory account, not0.5*standalone NAVs. ETF candidate cash remains cash and is not reassigned to stocks

minimal_account_interface.structure: One portfolio cash balance and totalNAV, two typed inventory/event adapters: STOCK for existing lots/tax/mergers, ETF for fund units/ticks/consolidation. Family allocations are planning budgets, not funded NAV sleeves or synthetic capital transfers
minimal_account_interface.do_not_patch_old_sources: New isolated mixed runner/adapter may reuse existing helpers; old stock Account and accepted ETF runner source/result files remain unchanged
minimal_account_interface.net_targets: Form stock and ETF unit targets at signal close; union targets with actual owned symbols, so exits appear as zero targets. Trade net differences from actual holdings, never import child-account inventory
minimal_account_interface.active_family_schedule: Stock targets update at indices divisible by5; ETF targets update only at indices divisible by20. A40-session outer node is both. Between ETF nodes hold its live units, including residuals, without adjusting ETF weights
minimal_account_interface.inactive_family_residuals: At each global five-session node set all holdings of an outer-inactive family to zero targets and attempt exit at next open. This explicit five-session exit retry is the only cross-family residual retry; no daily retries or deletion. ETF constituent exits while ETF family remains active are attempted again only at its next20-session node
minimal_account_interface.exit_failure: Failed exits remain real holdings with fees/tax/events/marks; identity lock does not imply100percent achieved allocation. Buys require actual available shared cash, no borrowing or fictitious immediate cash transfer
minimal_account_interface.order_formation: Signal-close NAV and raw close determine integer targets. Opening marks used only for execution constraints, not selection or target hindsight. Keep fees and cash reserve inside lot-rounded planning budgets
minimal_account_interface.execution_sequence: Apply due events and lot availability; all eligible stock and ETF sells before any buys. Preserve stock selected-ranking buy order and ETF class order csi300,sp500_qdii,physical_gold,rmb_gov_bond
minimal_account_interface.shared_cash_rationing: If combined preliminarily eligible buy cost including fees exceeds available cash, proportionally scale buy requests by their estimated all-in notional, floor using each instrument's lot rule, recheck fees and reduce until affordable; do not borrow or reallocate rounding remainder by performance. Then execute frozen stock-rank/ETF-class order
minimal_account_interface.order_expiry: Signal-close target order valid only next common session; remaining quantity expires. Later retries follow only the schedules above
minimal_account_interface.symbol_types: Explicit typed symbol namespace; an ETF cannot be routed through stock80/120,3percent cap, stock stamp/dividend tax or stock merger code
minimal_account_interface.valuation: totalNAV=cash+stock market value+ETF market value+valid outstanding receivables-estimated stock dividend tax liability; no double counting cash or fund units

stock.fee_routing: Reuse accepted2025/2026 date-specific equity fee components, original limit/lot/T+1 availability, acquisition-based dividend-tax and reviewed stock actions/mergers
stock.tax_distinction: Preserve old accepted multiplier semantics for transaction fee components; do not double acquisition-based dividend tax or silently exempt stocks

etf.fees: Inherit exact parent contract standard/stress ETF commission, minimum, slippage and exemption rules, with product/date lots,ticks,T+0/T+1 and price limits from bound product master
etf.capacity: Parent1percent prior20-session mean traded units, correctly adjusted for unit consolidation; no future full-day volume sizing
etf.events: Parent verified fund record/ex/payment dates, unit conversions and fractional rounding; actual entitlement based on this account's holdings, not standalone portfolio events
etf.cash_availability: Distribution payment at close is spendable next common open; verified secondary-market sale proceeds usable same day. No automatic reinvestment outside target nodes
etf.daily_range_rejection: Retain parent adverse tick-rounded slippage outside daily high/low no-fill rule. A simulated rejection, including Apr8, does not establish historical inability to trade. No clipping price to rescue a strategy

execution_costs_events.execution_price: Same next-session raw opening-price conventions and disclosed product-specific adapters for all four accounts; no fill at signal close
execution_costs_events.forward_information: Only source prices, PIT stock pools, frozen causal predictions and announced events known by each signal close; no later revised total-return data or future US underlying close
execution_costs_events.carry_events: Inactive/residual holdings still receive corporate actions and settlements; stock tax bases/acquisition dates and ETF receivables survive switching and year boundary

binding_and_engineering_gate.before_run: Coordinator/runner binds SHA256 of this contract, all input files, calendar, state mapping, predictions/rankings, stock rule/event/fee sources, ETF products/prices/events and new runner. Parent bindings are references, not proof new mixed engine is accepted
checks: Zero unsupported source gaps and causal state/score construction
No negative cash or illegal available lots
Typed stock/fund taxes,ticks,consolidation and merger events
Both-family sell-before-buy with rejected exits preserved
Shared cash, marks, receivables and estimated tax reconcile each session
No duplicated/dropped entitlements across stages and years
binding_and_engineering_gate.engineering_failure: Retain invalid output and report specific cause; fix correctness without changing rule/period. Never treat an invalid ledger as a strategy failure

evaluation.primary: After-cost zero-cash Sharpe=sqrt(252)*mean(all418 dailyNAV returns)/sample_std(ddof1); first cash day included with precedingNAV=initial capital
evaluation.zero_volatility: Undefined Sharpe cannot pass; no positive-infinity substitution
evaluation.coverage: Only full40-session stages count; final18-session stage is reported but not counted. Limited regime coverage means no meaningful mechanism test, not proof against the candidate
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired20-session moving-block bootstrap,2000 repetitions,seed20261010, of same-scenario stage-minus-fixed Sharpe; interval crossing zero precludes significant-improvement language but does not trigger parameter search
evaluation.existing_references: Reuse accepted same-period continuous E00/T01/S01 and four-ETF static standard/stress results without new accounts. Verify calendar/capital/first-signal and cost definitions, otherwise descriptive only
evaluation.replacement_claim: Passing stage-minus-fixed gate only supports selection increment for these two candidates. If not better than the best compatible existing reference, do not claim project-wide best strategy or replace it. No standalone ETF_R60_TOP2 evaluation is silently added
secondary: Daily gross/net exposures, cash and allocation drift
Each full/partial stage and year-segment performance
ETF score/selection and S01 inner E00/T01 choice
Rejected/partial fills, exit retry and residual exposure
Asset P&L contributions with reconciliation and separate yearly NAV denominators
evaluation.correlation_scope: Coordinator observed same-period T01-S01 correlation0.9033; ETF_FIXED correlations are descriptive and do not prove ETF_R60_TOP2 diversification. Do not fit or select weights from viewed correlations
evaluation.fail_stop: Failed valid gate: save all four accounts and stop this fixed selector. No automatic60/120-day score variants, threshold/weight/hold/start search, ETF substitution or model refit. A successful fixed comparator remains useful even when selection fails
evaluation.no_other_economic_gates: No static historical Sharpe>=1 prerequisite, no per-year winner rule or reinstated old drawdown veto

limitations: S01 is an existing compound stock policy;40-day outer lock is not40-day E00/T01 lock and does not eliminate internal trading
Choice of60/40/20 and50percent breadth is a financial/engineering hypothesis, not calibrated optimum
Small four-ETF pool, previously viewed period and limited independent stages; no universal or blind-test claim
Public third-party daily ETF prices, generic verified product limit assumptions and weaker2026 bond distribution source are inherited and disclosed
252-day filter only triggered once and its exit was unfilled in prior daily-bar model; that result does not justify calling trend theory ineffective
required_outputs: execution_binding.json with source mappings and hashes
Four mixed daily ledgers, typed orders/fills/rejections and stock/ETF event ledgers
Closing typed holdings/lots, receivables and stock dividend tax bases
summary.json with four-account comparison, gates, coverage, year/stage/asset attribution and reused references
independent_acceptance.json with reconciliation and timing/fee/event checks
